features.name: page_value_log
features.description: Smooths the highly skewed PageValues distribution using a log transformation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth, continuous feature that prevents large outliers from dominating the linear SVM margin.

features.name: bounce_exit_ratio
features.description: Calculates the ratio of BounceRates to ExitRates to measure the proportion of exits that are immediate bounces.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a normalized ratio feature that isolates immediate abandonment from general exit behavior, useful for linear weighting.

features.name: engagement_penalty
features.description: Sums BounceRates and ExitRates to create a composite penalty score for poor engagement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of negative engagement, allowing the SVM to learn a single linear penalty weight.

features.name: high_value_weekend
features.description: Interaction feature applying the log of PageValues only during weekends.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to fit a specific margin adjustment for high-value browsing that occurs on weekends.

features.name: special_day_urgency
features.description: Multiplies SpecialDay proximity by the log of PageValues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a weighted composite feature capturing the interaction between temporal urgency and page value for the linear decision boundary.

features.name: safe_exit_rate
features.description: Subtracts BounceRates from ExitRates to measure non-bounce exits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an approximate linear projection of safe exits, separating them from the more severe bounce exits.

features.name: visitor_intent_score
features.description: A semantic score evaluating the user's underlying intent based on VisitorType, TrafficType, and Region.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects high-cardinality categorical metadata into a single continuous intent dimension, ideal for linear SVM margins.

features.name: seasonal_activity_index
features.description: An index representing the typical shopping activity level for the given Month and SpecialDay.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts categorical temporal data into a smooth, continuous seasonal activity measure.

features.name: tech_stack_modernity
features.description: A continuous score assessing the modernity and typical performance of the user's Browser and OperatingSystems combination.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the SVM to linearly weight the technological capability of the user's device without dealing with sparse one-hot encoded categories.

features.name: administrative_engagement_level
features.description: A continuous assessment of the user's administrative engagement, combining Administrative and Administrative_Duration categories into a smooth score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms categorical duration and count representations into a linear-friendly continuous severity measure.

features.name: product_exploration_depth
features.description: A semantic measure of how deeply the user explored products, based on ProductRelated and ProductRelated_Duration categories.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of product interest, allowing the linear model to assign a proportional weight to exploration depth.

features.name: informational_seeking_intensity
features.description: A continuous score reflecting the intensity of the user's search for information, derived from Informational and Informational_Duration categories.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects categorical informational browsing behavior into a smooth numerical scale, optimizing the linear SVM's feature space.
